notes.title: Minor patch 2025-2.16.0
notes.notes: This patch simply fixes a minor issue on the mission "Capitol Coup" wherein destroying all the turrets on the Requiem will cause it to spontaneous flip 180 degrees and start flying backwards towards the light jump point.

notes.title: Rogue Stargun Valentine's Update
notes.notes:
This patch update brings in several changes:
 - Bugfix for "Locate Missing Scientists" wherein the mission would start from the perspective of an external camera rather than the player cockpit.
 - Enemy weapon damage has been tuned down, making the later levels (where enemy fighters have advanced AI) more forgiving.
 - Saurian Raptor Elites have received a visual upgrade, looking distinct from their vanilla counterparts.


[b]Gamepads like the Xbox controller are now partially supported[/b]. It is not recommended to use a gamepad for this game, and stick to using VR controls (which should track the rotation of your controllers whenever you grab the flightstick in-game). However the following mappings should now work for gamepads. [b]This may be useful for players who want to map such controls to a HOTAS flightstick[/b]


Controls:
Fire -> Right trigger
Fire secondary -> Right shoulder
Next Target -> Button South ("A" on Xbox)
NextIff -> Button North ("Y" on Xbox)
Scan Front -> Left Trigger
Shield Distribute -> Hold Button West ("X" on XBox) and use D-pad up/down or left/right to balance
Toggle Turret (Tornado Only) -> Hold Button West and right stick press
Match Target Speed-> Button East ("B" on Xbox); exclusive to using gamepad controls

Movement:
Rudder -> Left stick X-axis
Throttle -> Left stick Y-axis
Pitch and Yaw -> Right stick

notes.title: Update 2025.2.2.7 - Higher intensity missions, juicy UI, improved enemy AI
notes.notes:
This update brings in a large amount of polish oriented changes.
[list]
[*] "Defend Alpha Base" and "Assault WarpGate" missions now have timed survival sections and large enemy fighter waves to increase narrative tension.
[*] Enemy fighters now no longer break off contact prematurely to avoid collisions and are more willing to do head on assaults as well as more aggressive in tailing the player. 
[*] More UI "juiciness" with some UI buttons expanding and contracting on hover.
[*] There is now the ability to delete saves.
[*] More shader reduction to reduce VRAM usage and speed up level loads and startup times.
[*] Powerups have been tweaked. Level 3 crates can now drop "Full Restore"
[*] Shield damage and hull damage now throw sparks in the cockpit.
[*] Shield redirect has been fixed. Shields no longer need to be in overboost to use the redirect feature.
[*] Firing arcs on a number of turrets has been reduced to eliminate "self-damage"
[*] The final boss on "Final Duel" is much more dangerous carrying 3 forward weapons along with AI improvements described above. Reinforcements now only spawn when the boss shield goes down, and a much smaller number of reinforcements spawns.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 2025.1.8.4 - Numerous Bugfixes
notes.notes:
Numerous gameplay tweaks from the second half of 2024:
[list]
[*] Bugfix: Aero-B control flightstick left thumbstick yaw should now work properly
[*] Bugfix: On starting a completely fresh game, the default flight controls should be "Aero"
[*] Improved enemy AI. Elite enemy fighters and Cybron Remotes now lead their targets, particularly in the higher levels (past Cybron Space).
[*] Deadlier enemy AI. Higher difficulty enemies now gimbal their guns within a certain firing arc to achieve greater accuracy.
[*] Deadlier enemy weapons. Firing rate and velocity have been increased on the Saurian Raptor Elite, Saurian Cerabomber Elite, Pirate Corsair, and Cybron Remote.
[*] Major bugfix: Bullets no longer penetrate the player's shield
[*] Major AI improvement
[*] Dependency on Meta and Oculus libraries removed in favor of OpenXR
[*] Unity Engine update to 6.000.0.32f1 (bleeding edge LTS version)
[*] Substantial reduction in shader count to reduce VRAM usage and load times by removing unnecessary render pipeline options
[*] Friendly fire now only inflicts 20% hull damage (sill inflicts 100% damage for shields)
[*]  When the Requiem jumps out, it would fire a warp jump audio cue for every enemy bullet hitting it overloading the audio system and killing music.
[*] In "Destroy Arrow Station" the Requiem will now fire its forward heavy guns at the station if it reaches proper alignment.
[*] Art asset fixes in Neotica city
[*] Lightmaps for all terrestrial missions
[*] Powerups including class 4 powerups are present in the very last mission, making it slightly less difficult.
[*] Removed several buggy materials.
[*] Fixed explosion audio cues on space station and capitol ship destruction.
[*] Fixed warp in audio cues on a number of missions when ships jump in.
[*] Galactic Carriers can now fire their main weapons if a target is directly in front of them.
[*] Several particle effects like bullet sparks and shield destruction effects are now no longer transparent leading to major performance in FPS on ultra low end laptops. By removing transparency, these effects no longer depend on the depth buffer and can be GPU batched efficiently for rendering.
[*] The control scheme selection screen at the start of the game now has text indicating that the controls are rotation tracking to mitigate player confusion about how the control scheme works.
[*] The Tornado Bomber now is equipped with homing bombs which have been reduced in count from 20 to 8. These bombs are effected by gravity on planetary missions. The low angle firing option has also been reduced from an angle of 30 to an angle 25 degrees off center.
[*] Player homing missiles and superior homing missiles are much, much more effective.
[*] If the Capitol Station is somehow destroyed, it will properly break up into pieces rather than transforming into a destroyed Citadel station.
[*] The Cybron Remote is now much more likely to attempt to strike targets close by, particularly in the "Missing Scientists" mission.
[/list]
